newsitem.title: USA: Barrett says major eyeing U.S. Gulf tract.
newsitem.headline: Barrett says major eyeing U.S. Gulf tract.

text.p: Barrett Resources Corp has been approached by a major oil company interested in its stake in a Gulf of Mexico tract where it recently drilled a dry hole, company executives said.
Paul Rady, president of the Denver-based independent oil and natural gas company, did not identify the major interested in its High Island A-545 stake but said talks would begin shortly.
"We were approached recently by a major very interested in looking into farming into the block," he said. "There's been a lot of people knocking on our doors."
Barrett acquired the High Island A-545 drilling rights for about $13 million in a September 1996 federal lease sale and spent $4.2 million in drilling costs, the company said.
Barrett has been an aggressive bidder in recent Gulf of Mexico lease rounds as the company expands outside its core Rocky Mountain plays.
